name: DealerStandardsAuditManager
tagline: Run OEM retailer standards audits, close corrective actions with evidence and protect the standards bonus – in one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: A complete dealer standards audit app for Power Apps and Power Pages: audit walk checklist per dealer, findings register, corrective-action board with evidence and verification, weighted compliance score against the bonus threshold, bonus at risk and a dealer × area heat map. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Weighted compliance score vs bonus threshold
Bulk owner / due date / mark compliant
Demo mode with fictional sample network
